description: Experimental API to convert Thunderbird filters to/from lightweight identifiers.

functions.name: convertFilterToApi
functions.description: Convert a Thunderbird filter to a tuple containing account URI and filter name.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The native Thunderbird filter object (privileged only).

functions.name: convertFilterFromApi
functions.description: Finds and returns a Thunderbird filter from a given account/name combo.

returns.description: The matched nsIMsgFilter object, or a proxy reference if needed.

functions.name: getFilters
functions.description: Retrieves an array of filters (filter names?)

parameters.name: sourceUri
parameters.description: folder URI to find account where filters are stored (applied inbox)

parameters.name: targetUri
parameters.description: folder URI targeted by filters (move / copy to). omit to list all filters for thge account

parameters.name: filterAction
parameters.description: Optional: filter action type to match (e.g., MoveToFolder, Delete, AddTag, Custom)

parameters.name: filterActionExt
parameters.description: Optional: extended filter action info (e.g., tag name for AddTag, customId for Custom actions)

returns.description: Array of filter objects, each containing filterName, accountId, type, templateName (if applicable), description, enabled, matchedActionType, and matchedActionExt
